pages.title: Mum's Shepherd's Pie
pages.text: The best food in the game. It isn't close.$(br2)Restores almost a full hunger bar, heals you for 20 seconds and gives you two extra hearts of padding for two minutes.
Cooked mutton, two baked potatoes, a carrot, an onion (Farmer's Delight) and a bowl. Mum's recipe. Not up for discussion.
